dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm... looks like you're pretty free today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: If you're asking from the perspective of comfort... I like it very much.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But in my professional opinion... I think there's a lot of potential here that's not really being fully utilized.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I mean, for starters, you don't even have to worry about mitigating natural disasters — or any other external risk factors for that matter. So that makes your land-use planning process a whole lot simpler.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The main consideration for you is how to make the best use of the available space...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Beyond that, you really want to think about the proportional allocation of resources...

choices.text: I think I got the general gist...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ah... don't mind me. I slipped back into work mode.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's your home, after all, you should be the one to shape it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Sure, why not?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Though I should warn you, most people aren't exactly enamored with my conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, what do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well, for example, a colleague once asked me: "Is there anything I can help you with, Ms. Keqing?"

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: To which I replied: "You can start by worrying about your own work rate."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: After that, they never approached me again.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Another person asked me: "Do you have any gift suggestions for Lady Ningguang?"

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: To which I replied: "Don't bother. Ningguang has no time for suck-ups."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yeah... Anyway, so now you know.

choices.text: Sounds like you're just a bit of a straight talker.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yeah... I just think if you've got something to say, there's no point mincing your words.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Sugar-coating the facts, kind lies... it's all a big waste of everyone's time.

choices.text: Getting to the point is certainly... underrated.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Exactly. See? You understand where I'm coming from.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I was right all along, we've got a lot in common.

choices.text: Still, doesn't being so blunt all the time affect what other people think of you?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I couldn't care less what those people think of me.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: ...Well, that might make me think twice.

choices.text: I don't think you did anything bad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Sure, let's arrange an evening when both of us are free.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: A little while ago, I took some time to survey every inch of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I found three locations where the scenery was quite beautiful, it really resonated with me.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: One of them was perfect for stargazing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: So, are you interested?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I was a little apprehensive actually, I was wondering how I could convince you if you refused at first...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Personally, I consider it... a reward... for completing a stage of my work.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Rare blessings like these... we mustn't let them go to waste.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Now that I know you don't have any reservations, you better go and work it into your schedule!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The sooner the better, as far as I'm concerned.

choices.text: I never knew you had a stargazing hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ahem... Well, that's enough small talk for now. Call me if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #Night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Wait! Remember... Don't put off until tomorrow what you haven't finished today.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You can just hand it off to me instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: As I thought, you've carefully observed the streets of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Your understanding of the layout of stores and vendors is most detailed.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Would you be interested in discussing plans to improve Chihu Rock with me?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Getting a good rest is indeed key to being productive in one's work.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: This bedroom has everything, except for one item: it needs a clock to gauge time with.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'll find some time to accompany you to shop for a clock, lest you oversleep and miss something important.
